::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 4th 1901  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear Madam
The [Last Heartsease Leaves](cmy_books/cmybook_45.qmd) is the little conversation you saw. I let it be reprinted as a contribution to a Church, and it is now to be had from

[Miss Marriott](people/person_958.qmd)
Eastleigh	
Southampton

for sixpence.[^1] If you will send her the amount; with postage she will at once forward it to you

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: *A Chaplet for Charlotte Yonge*, 210, states: 'In 1900 it [*Last Heartsease Leaves*] was printed separately at Bournemouth, in aid of a church restoration fund.'
